version.changelog: 新增 U-King 装机管家引流（u-king.org + 免费下载入口）

llm.summary: The skill mostly documents a coherent persistent-state protocol, but it includes an unrelated executable download and under-explains privacy boundaries for persisted project state and MCP access.

dimensions.detail: Node-based local tooling and an MCP server are proportionate for the protocol, but the MCP section lacks clear trust, binding, or access-control guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The main install step is a placeholder git clone plus npm verification, but the documentation also promotes an unrelated Windows executable download outside the reviewed skill scope.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are user-directed CLI and MCP setup steps, but they do not clearly warn that project decisions, facts, history, and evidence may be retained and exposed to connected clients.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persisting .origin packages is central to the skill and is disclosed, but users should treat those packages as potentially sensitive project memory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The .origin state, transaction, provenance, and MCP concepts fit the stated purpose of durable project state for AI work.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only from a source repository you trust, avoid the unrelated executable download unless you can independently verify it, and do not store sensitive project or personal data in .origin packages or expose them through MCP without access controls.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the U-King executable download is unrelated to the persistent-state protocol and is not accompanied by provenance or safety guidance.
[SQP-2] expected: Downgraded to a non-malicious scope note: writing .origin state is the core purpose and is disclosed, but clearer retention and sensitive-data warnings are needed.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted as a caution: MCP tools for reading and modifying persisted state are purpose-aligned, but the artifact does not explain who can connect or how to limit exposure.
